svg.title: where Q4 is the fixed fourth-degree invariant curvature correction. The finest path has row √ b times the elementary plaquette curvature, zero loop and cubic tensors, and quartic tensor bQ4 on the same plaquette. Thus its quadratic-plus-quartic part is the corresponding local Taylor polynomial. It uses the entire plaquette footprint, including a wrapping plaquette.
